ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, correlationId: correlationId, errorType: "APIKIT:BAD_REQUEST", message: "Bad request payload or invalid parameters", details: error.description }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, correlationId: correlationId, errorType: "APIKIT:NOT_FOUND", message: "Resource not found", details: error.description }

logger.doc:name: Log Manual API Trigger
logger.message: Manual report run requested via REST API.

when.expression: #[ vars.requestBody == null or isEmpty(trim((vars.requestBody.entityCode default '') as String)) or isEmpty(trim((vars.requestBody.reportType default '') as String)) or isEmpty(trim((vars.requestBody.periodStart default '') as String)) or isEmpty(trim((vars.requestBody.periodEnd default '') as String)) ]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "ERROR", errorType: "INVALID_REQUEST", message: "Required fields are missing or blank.", requiredFields: [ "entityCode", "reportType", "periodStart", "periodEnd" ] }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "ERROR", errorType: "INVALID_REPORTING_PERIOD", message: "Both periodStart and periodEnd are required." }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "ERROR", errorType: "INVALID_REPORTING_PERIOD", message: "periodStart must be earlier than periodEnd." }

db:select.doc:name: Validate Entity and Report Type
db:select.db:sql: SELECT entity_code, report_type FROM compliance_report_control WHERE entity_code = :entityCode AND report_type = :reportType

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "ERROR", errorType: "INVALID_ENTITY_OR_REPORT_TYPE", message: "The entity code and report type are not configured for compliance reporting." }

logger.doc:name: Log Fetch Run
logger.message: Fetching audit details for Run ID: #[vars.targetRunId]

db:select.doc:name: Query Run Audit Record
db:select.db:sql: SELECT run_id, entity_code, entity_name, report_type, period_start, period_end, sequence_number, is_revision, record_count, total_amount, customer_count, completeness_result, is_nil_report, output_file_path, archive_file_path, summary_file_path, checksum, notification_status, trigger_source, run_status, error_message, correlation_id, started_at, completed_at FROM compliance_report_runs WHERE run_id = :runId LIMIT 1

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var r = payload[0] --- { runId: r.run_id, entityCode: r.entity_code, entityName: r.entity_name, reportType: r.report_type, periodStart: r.period_start as String, periodEnd: r.period_end as String, sequenceNumber: r.sequence_number, isRevision: r.is_revision == 1 or r.is_revision == true, recordCount: r.record_count, totalAmount: r.total_amount as Number, customerCount: r.customer_count, completenessResult: r.completeness_result, isNilReport: r.is_nil_report == 1 or r.is_nil_report == true, outputFilePath: r.output_file_path, archiveFilePath: r.archive_file_path, summaryFilePath: r.summary_file_path, checksum: r.checksum, notificationStatus: r.notification_status, triggerSource: r.trigger_source, runStatus: r.run_status, errorMessage: r.error_message, correlationId: r.correlation_id, startedAt: r.started_at as String, completedAt: if (r.completed_at != null) (r.completed_at as String) else null }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, correlationId: correlationId, errorType: "COMPLIANCE:RUN_NOT_FOUND", message: "Compliance report run not found for ID: " ++ (vars.targetRunId default "") }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var lim = (attributes.queryParams.limit default 20) as Number var off = (attributes.queryParams.offset default 0) as Number var status = attributes.queryParams.status --- { limit: if (lim > 100) 100 else if (lim < 1) 20 else lim, offset: if (off < 0) 0 else off, status: status }

db:select.doc:name: Query Run History List
db:select.db:sql: SELECT run_id, entity_code, entity_name, report_type, period_start, period_end, sequence_number, is_revision, record_count, total_amount, customer_count, completeness_result, is_nil_report, output_file_path, archive_file_path, summary_file_path, checksum, notification_status, trigger_source, run_status, error_message, correlation_id, started_at, completed_at FROM compliance_report_runs WHERE (:status IS NULL OR run_status = :status) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var runs = payload default [] --- { total: sizeOf(runs), limit: vars.queryParams.limit, offset: vars.queryParams.offset, runs: runs map ((r) -> { runId: r.run_id, entityCode: r.entity_code, entityName: r.entity_name, reportType: r.report_type, periodStart: r.period_start as String, periodEnd: r.period_end as String, sequenceNumber: r.sequence_number, isRevision: r.is_revision == 1 or r.is_revision == true, recordCount: r.record_count, totalAmount: r.total_amount as Number, customerCount: r.customer_count, completenessResult: r.completeness_result, isNilReport: r.is_nil_report == 1 or r.is_nil_report == true, outputFilePath: r.output_file_path, archiveFilePath: r.archive_file_path, summaryFilePath: r.summary_file_path, checksum: r.checksum, notificationStatus: r.notification_status, triggerSource: r.trigger_source, runStatus: r.run_status, errorMessage: r.error_message, correlationId: r.correlation_id, startedAt: r.started_at as String, completedAt: if (r.completed_at != null) (r.completed_at as String) else null }) }
